mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4, significantly increasing atazanavir plasma concentrations and prolonging QT interval; atazanavir also inhibits CYP3A4, creating bidirectional inhibition with risk of cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Avoid co-administration; use alternative macrolide (azithromycin) or non-macrolide antibiotic if necessary, with ECG monitoring if combination unavoidable.
